Queries.Name: directory.lookup
Queries.Sql:
SELECT t0.id, u.id
FROM directory.tenant_domains AS t
INNER JOIN directory.tenants AS t0 ON t.tenant_id = t0.id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT e.user_id
    FROM directory.external_identities AS e
    WHERE e.issuer = @issuer AND e.subject = @subject
) AS e0
INNER JOIN directory.users AS u ON e0.user_id = u.id
WHERE t.host = @host AND t.is_verified AND t0.is_active AND u.is_active
LIMIT 2

Queries.Name: dispatcher.detail
Queries.Sql:
SELECT w.tenant_id, w.id, w.created_at, w.customer_user_id, w.description, w.provider_user_id, w.status, w.version
FROM work_orders AS w
WHERE w.tenant_id = @ef_filter__TenantId AND w.tenant_id = @membership_TenantId AND w.id = @orderId
LIMIT 2

Queries.Name: dispatcher.list.first
Queries.Sql:
SELECT w.id AS "Id", w.description AS "Description", w.status AS "Status", w.version AS "Version", w.created_at AS "CreatedAt"
FROM work_orders AS w
WHERE w.tenant_id = @ef_filter__TenantId AND w.tenant_id = @membership_TenantId
ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.id DESC
LIMIT @p

Queries.Name: dispatcher.membership
Queries.Sql:
SELECT m.tenant_id, m.user_id, m.is_active, m.permissions
FROM memberships AS m
WHERE m.tenant_id = @ef_filter__TenantId AND m.user_id = @actor
LIMIT 2
